articles.title: Mahomes tears ACL as Chiefs' playoff hopes end
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes suffered a torn ACL in the closing minutes of Sunday's loss to the Chargers, an MRI confirmed. "Don't know why this had to happen," he wrote on social media. "And not going to lie, [it] hurts."
